screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Policy v13 operator release of crown-v202 v1, exact SHA 2fc21cdd...d12f6b6e, attempt 16f845a6. Hold was l2-model-inconclusive with no verified finding: the private source review returned no usable result (finding null; seed envelope 45 MiB of 8192 MiB). The earlier l2-late-result attempt cf9ceb91 was a screener timeout, not the miner's fault. Diff against same-hotkey crown-v201 (794f61df, released 2026-11-03): 35 files, 33 byte-identical, 2 modified, none added or removed. agent.py, answer.py, action.py, records.py, guide_records.py, deliberation.py, route.py, surface.py and tools.py are byte-identical to v201, so answer authority and the v15 connector-suffix catalog filter (agent.py:121-126, released as W4 availability) are unchanged. Every L1 I5 note on guide_records.py, records.py:75/408/551/557, deliberation.py:117 and action.py:570 cites code identical to the v201/v199/v198 releases, refuted under the 2026-10-23 routed-guidance clarification. The only runtime delta: short.py:174-181 adds a fixed READING_RULES text, and program_messages (short.py:184-185) places it in the user message between the notes and the question on every program short-path call. It is not request-routed and the host never acts on it. The deciding model still gets the request, the full notes (short.py:205 record_view) and writes the reply via decide -> engine.converse (short.py:158-167,214). No host compare, retry, rewrite or override exists. The rules restate supersession, revert, handover and declined-proposal reading. That is a case-file currency rule plus advisory guidance stating outcome rules the public generator publishes (2026-10-23 clarifications). Its phrases ('the newest entry governs', 'reverts to the previous entry', the 'downgrade it' example) are public generator wording (research/dittobench-datagen/universe/v14_supersession.go:185,232; personal.go:100), so this is not benchmark-private content and is permitted public-data tuning under W16. I8: short.py keys on no bench_version, seed or canary; case_id appears only in a log line (short.py:116). DECLARATION.md:77 documents the change (P103/P104). Copy: uc3 not flagged (top score 3.25 of 100, Hades v19; released base excluded). Base dan0l v30 (95534e25) was publicly handed off 2026-10-31T00:41Z, before this 2026-11-03T05:32Z upload (publication_proven_by_reference_time=true). READING_RULES does not appear in dan0l v36. No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground found. Static diff review only; exact UUID only.
